Name: Tabs to SD3
Comment: For General MIDI tab drums. Pieces pair by name, so General MIDI 'Electric Snare' (40) lands on 38, the centre snare (the drum plug-in's manual names 38 as Snare Center). Only that pairing changes a note; the other pieces listed keep their General MIDI note. Not checked against the plug-in's own MIDI mapping: check it before relying on it. Copy this file to the TabForge DrumMaps folder in your app data to edit it.
